In algebraic geometry, a '''Nori motive''' is a [[mixed motive (math)|mixed motive]] constructed by [[Madhav V. Nori|Madhav Nori]]. Today, it is known that Nori's 1-motive coincides with that of Ayoub.<ref>Joseph Ayoub, Luca Barbieri-Viale, Nori 1-motives, arXiv:1206.5923 [math.AG]</ref>

The construction is based on '''Nori's basic lemma''' and his [[Tannakian theorem]].<ref>§ 4.4.4., Bruno Kahn, Algebraic K-Theory, Algebraic Cycles and Arithmetic Geometry in Handbook of K-Theory.</ref>
